opportunities.title: Balancer Isn't Restructuring. It's Being Buried.
opportunities.why_now: Balancer just proposed winding down and distributing its remaining treasury to BAL holders after a hack-driven revenue collapse it never recovered from.
opportunities.angle: Postmortem/obituary format tracing the hack-to-death timeline, framed as the inevitable endgame we've seen before with other exploited protocols

opportunities.title: The $7.8M Bug Was One Line of Code — Here's the Line
opportunities.why_now: CoinDesk just published the technical breakdown of exactly how a simple coding mistake let a hacker drain $7.8 million, giving us a rare concrete root-cause to dissect.
opportunities.angle: Line-by-line technical teardown for developers/auditors — 'read this before you ship' security explainer

opportunities.title: Symbiosis Got 15 BTC Back and Is Now Paying the Hacker to Keep the Rest
opportunities.why_now: Symbiosis just recovered 15 BTC from its bridge exploiter and is offering a 20% bounty, reviving the tired 'whitehat negotiation' playbook.
opportunities.angle: Cynical breakdown of the recovery-bounty ritual as institutionalized ransom, with a scoreboard of past bridge-hack 'negotiations'

opportunities.title: CoinEx Didn't Get Hacked This Time — It Just Ran Out of Reasons to Exist
opportunities.why_now: CoinEx is shutting down after 9 years citing market slump, a quiet exchange death happening the same week Balancer is winding down too.
opportunities.angle: Trend piece: 'quiet exchange deaths' as the other side of the security coin — no exploit needed when the business model was already priced to fail

opportunities.title: Revolut Got Phished by a Fake Government Email — What That Says About Everyone Else
opportunities.why_now: Revolut disclosed customer data exposure via a fake government email, showing even well-resourced fintechs fall for basic social engineering.
opportunities.angle: Security-led explainer on government-impersonation phishing as an underrated attack vector, with a checklist for spotting it
